title: Repeat with a loop
prompt: Return text repeated times times in a row, built with a loop. Zero times gives an empty string. ("ab", 3) gives "ababab".
hints: Start with an empty string and add text to it once per loop turn.

docs.name: for c in text:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines once per character, with c holding each one.

docs.name: range(n)
docs.what: The numbers 0 up to n - 1, for a for loop to count through.

docs.name: text + text
docs.what: Joins two strings into one. Numbers must be turned into text first.
